question: What is the value of external liṅga worship without knowledge of this inner sign?
premises: Some worship an external fixed liṅga with a heart separated from knowledge of this sign.
Mere effort without that knowledge does not yield the intended fruit.
inference: External liṅga worship is fruitless when disconnected from knowledge of the inner sign.
plain_english: Those whose hearts lack knowledge of this sign worship an external liṅga in vain; that is mere effort and cannot bring the true fruit.
